svg.title: Cybersecurity requirements traced to threat scenarios
svg.desc: A matrix of the cybersecurity requirements against the threat scenarios they treat, with chips naming the safety functions each requirement supports. One scenario, a sensing attack outside the security level target, has no requirement.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Figure 4-1 Cybersecurity requirements against the threat scenarios of WP-C-07

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 24 requirements, 20 scenarios. A dot marks a treatment; chips name the safety functions a requirement supports; column heads are shaded by the residual risk after treatment
